title: Musk Teases SpaceX-Tesla Merger in Earnings Call
description: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to explore a potential merger, a preliminary step toward what would rank as the largest corporate tie-up of all time. Ed Ludlow shares the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nextdc Shares Plunge After Public Backlash Hits Data Center
description: Nextdc Ltd.’s shares plummeted after the data center operator said it was considering force majeure options and cut earnings guidance as community opposition delayed one of its major projects in Melbourne.

title: Ken Griffin Says AI ‘Almost Certainly’ in a Bubble Right Now
description: Billionaire Ken Griffin said investors are “almost certainly” in the midst of an artificial intelligence bubble as many companies are still grappling with just how much they’ll spend on the technology and how it will transform the economy.
